name: cv
title: CV / Résumé
description: Publishes one of your pages as the live CV. Any page can be a CV — pick which one is current, attach a PDF, and put the download button where you want it.
note: A CV is an ordinary page. Set "page" to the one that's current — "pages/resume", or just "resume" — and it's published at "url". Start from plugins/cv/sample-cv.md if you'd like a CV-shaped page to edit; write your own if you wouldn't.
